identity.description: An attacker modifies a Windows registry key to ensure a malicious script executes at system startup. Cortex detects this behavior through registry modification events and process creation from the script file.

techniques.name: Boot or Logon Autostart Execution: Registry Run Keys / Startup Folder

expected_artifacts.description: Script file created in public directory

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Script file added to startup-related Registry keys
biocs.description: Detection of script file added to a startup-related registry key
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.REGISTRY
| filter action_file_path = "HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run"
| filter action_process_image_name = "C:\\Windows\\System32\\reg.exe"
| filter action_file_path contains "script.bat"

abiocs.name: Unusual registry modification followed by script execution
abiocs.description: Detection of registry modification to startup folder followed by execution of script file
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.REGISTRY and action_file_path = "HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run"
| join (dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = "C:\\Windows\\System32\\cmd.exe") on causality_actor_process_image_name = actor_process_image_name
| filter action_file_path contains "script.bat"
